title: Safeguard Custom Platform Script
description: JSON Schema for Safeguard Custom Platform scripts. Provides autocomplete and hover help for editors while remaining permissive enough to allow valid edge-case scripts.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor support. SPP ignores unknown top-level properties.

Id.description: Unique platform identifier used by Safeguard.

BackEnd.description: Execution backend. Custom platform scripts always use "Scriptable".

Meta.description: Optional free-form metadata for humans, such as version, notes, prerequisites, or warnings.

Imports.description: Optional import libraries. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

Import.description: Alias for Imports. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

Functions.description: Optional array of reusable named function definitions.

CheckSystem.description: Validates connectivity and service account access.

CheckPassword.description: Verifies the current managed account password.

CheckSshKey.description: Verifies whether an SSH key is configured.

ChangeSshKey.description: Adds, updates, or removes SSH keys.

CheckFile.description: Validates a file-based credential or artifact.

ChangeFile.description: Updates a file-based credential or artifact.

EnableAccount.description: JIT operation that enables an account.

DisableAccount.description: JIT operation that disables an account.

ElevateAccount.description: JIT operation that elevates an account.

DemoteAccount.description: JIT operation that demotes an account.

UpdateDependentSystem.description: Updates a dependent system after credential rotation.

DiscoverAccounts.description: Discovery operation that emits discovered accounts.

DiscoverServices.description: Discovery operation that emits discovered services.

DiscoverAssets.description: Discovery operation that emits discovered assets.

DiscoverApiKeys.description: Discovery operation that emits discovered API keys.

DiscoverSshHostKey.description: Discovers SSH host keys during asset onboarding.

DiscoverAuthorizedKeys.description: Discovers authorized SSH keys on the target.

RemoveAuthorizedKey.description: Removes an authorized SSH key from the target.

parameterType.description: Parameter data type. Matches the DataType enum in the scripting engine.

parameterDefinition.description: Describes a single parameter including its type, whether it is required, and an optional default value.

Required.description: Whether Safeguard must supply a value before the operation can run. Defaults to true.

DefaultValue.description: Optional default value used when no explicit value is provided.

Description.description: Optional human-readable description for administrators and editor hovers.

parameterObject.description: A single-key object where the property name is the parameter name and the value describes that parameter.

parameterArray.description: Ordered list of parameter declarations for an operation or function.

functionDefinition.description: A named reusable function definition. Must have a Name and a Do block.

Name.description: Function name referenced by Function commands.

Do.description: Ordered list of commands to execute.

operationDefinition.description: An operation entry point. Declare Parameters and provide Do with the steps to execute.

Do.description: The command list that the engine executes for this operation.

knownCommandPayload.description: Commands accept various payload shapes depending on the command type. This schema stays permissive at the payload level.

knownNestedCommandObject.description: Single-key command object used by classic Do blocks. The key is the command name.

AwsFunction.description: Invoke an AWS Lambda function or AWS API call.

BaseAddress.description: Set the base URL that relative request paths resolve against.

Break.description: Exit the current loop or return early from a function.

ClearCookie.description: Remove a cookie from the current HTTP session state.

Comment.description: Add an inline note that does not affect runtime behavior.

CompareMacOsPasswordHash.description: Compare a password against a macOS directory-service hash.

ComparePasswordHash.description: Compare a password against a salted hash.

CompareShadowHash.description: Compare a password against a salted /etc/shadow hash entry.

CompareUnixPasswordHash.description: Compare a password against a general Unix password hash.

Condition.description: Branch execution using an If expression with Then and optional Else blocks.

Connect.description: Open an SSH or Telnet session and create a connection object.

CryptMd5.description: Generate an MD5 crypt hash from input text.

Declare.description: Declare and initialize a variable (alias for SetItem).

Disconnect.description: Close an existing connection object and end the session.

DiscoverSshHostKey.description: Retrieve SSH host key data for asset trust workflows.

Eval.description: Evaluate an expression for side effects or object manipulation.

ExecuteCommand.description: Run a remote command in batch mode and capture stdout, stderr, and exit status.

ExecuteDependentCommand.description: Invoke a dependency-related command exposed to the script.

ExtractFormData.description: Parse HTML response content into a reusable form object.

ExtractJsonObject.description: Parse JSON content into an object the script can inspect.

For.description: Repeat a block a fixed number of times.

ForEach.description: Iterate over each item in a collection.

GetCookie.description: Read a cookie value from the current HTTP session state.

GetFormData.description: Read form data from a previously extracted form (alias for GetFormValue).

GetFormValue.description: Read a field value from an extracted HTML form object.

Headers.description: Add or update HTTP headers on a request object.

HttpAuth.description: Apply HTTP authentication such as Basic, Bearer, or NTLM.

Log.description: Write a diagnostic message to the task log.

NewHttpRequest.description: Create a named HTTP request object for later configuration.

Receive.description: Read terminal output into a buffer variable.

Request.description: Execute an HTTP request and capture the response object.

Return.description: Exit the current operation or function and optionally return a value.

Send.description: Send interactive text or commands to a terminal session.

SetCookie.description: Create or overwrite a cookie value for later requests.

SetFormData.description: Set form data on a form object (alias for SetFormValue).

SetFormValue.description: Populate a field in a form object before submission.

SetItem.description: Create or update a variable in script state.

SmaAccountName.description: Resolve the service account name for the current operation context.

Split.description: Split text into an array using a delimiter or pattern.

SslRequest.description: Execute an HTTPS request with explicit SSL/TLS configuration.

Status.description: Report a progress update or user-facing status message.

Switch.description: Run one of several blocks based on a match value.

Throw.description: Raise an error and stop execution unless it is caught.

Try.description: Run a block with error handling via a Catch block.

UrlEncode.description: Encode text for safe use in URLs or form payloads.

VmwareSdkConnect.description: Connect to a VMware vSphere environment via SDK.

VmwareSdkDiscoverAssets.description: Discover assets in a VMware vSphere environment.

VmwareSdkDisconnect.description: Disconnect from a VMware vSphere environment.

Wait.description: Pause execution for a defined interval.

WriteDiscoveredSshKey.description: Emit a discovered SSH key record.

WriteResponseObject.description: Write a structured response object back to the platform task engine.

genericCommandObject.description: Fallback for commands not explicitly listed in the schema. The engine resolves commands by name at runtime.

command.description: A command inside a Do array. Known command names get autocomplete and hover help; the generic fallback permits any valid command shape.

commandArray.description: Ordered list of commands executed by an operation or function.
